title: Prusa MINI and MINI+ X-carriage interface
summary: A front-plane MINI X-carriage study combines the published 31.423 x 69.407 mm envelope with bearing and selected M3 interface datums.

provenance.name: Original Prusa MINI X-carriage STEP
provenance.scope: Selected circular-interface dimensions and component context inform an independently redrawn front-plane study; no STEP geometry is imported and schematic mount locations are not OEM manufacturing data.

provenance.name: Original Prusa MINI X-carriage STL
provenance.scope: The mesh bounds provide only the 31.423 x 69.407 mm front envelope; this study is not a printable replacement, exact outline or fitness claim.
